taxonomy.CHRONOLOGY_MILESTONE: existing Atlas event key, never rekeyed or duplicated
taxonomy.READING_UNIT: a distinct biblical literary/narrative teaching unit, multiple units can belong to one Atlas milestone
taxonomy.EXCERPT_CHOICE: a later approved essential/extended/full selected range; NONE approved
taxonomy.LITERARY_READING: a book-level prayer/wisdom/prophecy/epistle/apocalyptic unit that need not create a geolocated event

safeguards: Every proposed boundary remains unapproved until original scripture-text check in existing approved Bible editions
Reference proposals do not purport to be independent publisher selections
Public Ad Orientem Atlas keys, map pins, artworks, book versions and native reader remain unchanged
Overlap in published references is not evidence of double-counted chronological events
Source-family vote/short-selection consensus v7 cannot be mechanically reapplied to split subunits
Readings from Psalms require Catholic/Vulgate chapter-number reconciliation
Literary book-completeness audit of all 73 books is a separate gate: a proposed episode list cannot certify it

splitPlans.rationale: The story distinguishes cosmic creation from the creation of humanity.
The Fall contains disobedience, divine judgment/Protoevangelium, and expulsion.
Original milestone only covers one chapter; later flood ending needs separate continuity coverage.
Promise and solemn covenant rite are distinct sections.
Publisher-short form may cut across these internal episodes; splitting is for navigation, not final abridgement.
The brothers' betrayal and the father's grief are separate scenes.
Distinguishes liturgical institution from its immediate communication.
Food miracle and Sabbath command may warrant independent readings.
Idolatry/appeal versus consequences/intercession.
Construction/ritual setup and divine presence are not one act.
Preparation/procession distinct from outcome.

Decision and division are separate narrative movements.
The failed invocations and divine answer are distinct.
Journey/discouragement and divine revelation differ.
Covenant promulgation and religious reforms are different units.
Court relocation and fidelity trial are distinct.
